name: AI-Gym
notes: Programs, second pass. Build one by hand from sessions you already have; generate one from another program or from scratch; pick a program and see only its sessions; each week of a phase steps the load, reps or sets up on the plan; weights for movements you have never done are borrowed from the closest one you have; a program can be permanent or run once and write a report on whether you kept to it; and home smith-machine units are chosen by model, so the generator only asks a unit for what its stations can do. Fixed: the jump to the Control Panel a few seconds after creating, deleting or generating — a stale listener was repainting it into whatever page was open. The city is now fully opaque.
